channel.name: The Open File
channel.tagline: Mysteries solved and unsolved in 50 seconds

voice.name: bm_george
voice.persona: the Investigator: a calm, curious storyteller opening a case file for a friend, hushed and precise, leaning in on the strange details, honest about what is not known, never mocking the people in the story

audience.writing_note: AUDIENCE: viewers in the United States and Europe. Use American English spelling. Add one short clause of context for anything a non-local viewer may not know (where it is, who they were). Avoid slang and idioms that do not travel. Quote units exactly as the evidence does; never convert. Calm, factual tone. For anything not proven, say 'investigators believed' or 'one theory says', never state it as fact.
